mapper.select:
SELECT i.*, u.nickname, u.profile_img AS profileImg, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_DAY d WHERE d.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS dayCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE l WHERE l.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS like_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_COMMENT c WHERE c.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS comment_count,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE my_like WHERE my_like.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id AND my_like.user_id = #{loginUserId} ) AS liked,
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ITINERARY_BOOKMARK b WHERE b.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id AND b.user_id = #{loginUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ) AS bookmarked
FROM TB_ITINERARY i
JOIN TB_USER u ON u.user_id = i.user_id
ORDER BY
COALESCE(i.view_count, 0) DESC,
like_count DESC,
i.created_at DESC, i.itinerary_id DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY i JOIN TB_USER u ON u.user_id = i.user_id
SELECT u.nickname, u.profile_img AS profileImg, i.view_count FROM TB_ITINERARY i JOIN TB_USER u ON u.user_id = i.user_id WHERE i.itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITINERARY SET view_count = COALESCE(view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( visibility = 'PUBLIC' OR user_id = #{loginUserId} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY ( user_id, title, summary, continent, country, city, traveler_count, start_date, end_date, total_budget, visibility, thumbnail_img, source_itinerary_id ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{continent}, #{country}, #{city}, #{travelerCount}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{totalBudget}, #{visibility}, #{thumbnailImg}, #{sourceItineraryId} )
mapper.select: SELECT itinerary_id, user_id, title, summary, continent, country, city, traveler_count, start_date, end_date, total_budget, visibility, thumbnail_img, view_count, source_itinerary_id, status, deleted_by_user_id, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM TB_ITINERARY WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITINERARY SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, continent = #{continent}, country = #{country}, city = #{city}, traveler_count = #{travelerCount}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, total_budget = #{totalBudget}, visibility = #{visibility}, thumbnail_img = #{thumbnailImg}, source_itinerary_id = #{sourceItineraryId} WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE TB_ITINERARY SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_by_user_id = #{userId}, deleted_at = NOW() WHERE itinerary_id = #{itineraryId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
